findings.summary: delete prunes empty directories with os.removedirs, which keeps climbing past the root and removes the root and its empty parents.
Comments are cut at the first # anywhere on a line, so a # inside a string literal truncates the expression.
The constructor creates the root directory, so merely opening or listing a library that does not exist yet creates it (and fails where the directory cannot be created).

names() deletes dot-prefixed .tmp files, which are the temporary files _write is still filling for a save in progress, so listing a library writes to disk and makes a concurrent save fail at os.replace.
